No changes detected in this version (1.0.1) compared to 1.0.0.

- No file changes found.
- SKILL.md and all other files remain unchanged.

Initial release of makeup-transform-video.

- Generate short, high-impact makeup transformation videos for anthropomorphic animal characters.
- Supports various makeup styles (everyday, date, stage, cosplay, festive) and custom animal types.
- Workflow ensures user confirms all parameters (model, aspect ratio, duration, etc.) before video is generated, using a clear confirmation table.
- Prompts and parameters optimized for dramatic before/after contrast, rhythm, and clarity of makeup steps.
- Designed for fast-paced, short-form video (default 5 seconds, 9:16 vertical, no audio).
